title: 乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施
titleEn: Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations
subcategoryTitle: 核安全、除役與後端土木工程
subcategoryTitleEn: Nuclear safety, decommissioning and back-end civil works
summary: 用過核燃料在水池冷卻數年後，可以移到乾式貯存護箱：燃料裝在充氦的不鏽鋼密封筒內，外面套著厚重的混凝土或鋼製護箱，靠空氣自然對流散熱；美國自 1986 年起採用，全球已成為主要的中期貯存方式。課程定量分析每筒的熱負載、對流風量、填充氦氣、傾倒穩定性與護箱數量。
summaryEn: After some years of cooling in a pool, spent nuclear fuel can move to dry storage casks: fuel sits in a helium-filled stainless canister inside a massive concrete or steel overpack cooled by natural convection of air; used in the United States since 1986, it has become the main form of interim storage worldwide. The course quantifies heat load per canister, convective air flow, helium backfill, tip-over stability and the number of casks.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

v30FocusEn: Dry storage of spent fuel: sealed canisters, natural convection, shielding, tip-over stability and ageing management

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「半衰期與活度衰減」與「每個密封筒的熱負載」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Heat load of one canister": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「半衰期與活度衰減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Half-life and decay of activity" is correct?
options: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。
所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。
用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。
optionsEn: The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life.
All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years.
Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor.
quiz.explanation: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「半衰期與活度衰減」如何決定「乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Half-life and decay of activity” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。廢棄物的危害期長短取決於其中主要核種的半衰期：銫-137 與鍶-90 約三十年，經過三百年（十個半衰期）只剩約千分之一，這是低放射性廢棄物處置設施以數百年作為監管期的依據；長半衰期核種則需要深層地質處置把隔離時間拉長到數萬年以上。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life. How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：美國首座乾式貯存設施於 1986 年在薩里核電廠啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: The first US dry storage installation entered service at Surry in 1986
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「半衰期與活度衰減」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Half-life and decay of activity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 半衰期與活度衰減
knowledge.text: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。廢棄物的危害期長短取決於其中主要核種的半衰期：銫-137 與鍶-90 約三十年，經過三百年（十個半衰期）只剩約千分之一，這是低放射性廢棄物處置設施以數百年作為監管期的依據；長半衰期核種則需要深層地質處置把隔離時間拉長到數萬年以上。
knowledge.textEn: The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life. How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「半衰期與活度衰減」的模型 A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)，經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½) for "Half-life and decay of activity", which value is closest to the fraction of activity remaining after t years?
quiz.explanation: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 100 a、Thalf = 30.1 a，得 9.998 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 100 a, Thalf = 30.1 a the result is 9.998 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「半衰期與活度衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Half-life and decay of activity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 100 a、Thalf = 30.1 a，得 9.998 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 ty 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 100 a, Thalf = 30.1 a the result is 9.998 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise ty by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：ty 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.941 %（-20.6%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising ty by 10% changes the result to 7.941 % (-20.6%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 9.998 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 ty 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 9.998 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in ty with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 100 a、Thalf = 30.1 a，得 9.998 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。
knowledge.textEn: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 100 a, Thalf = 30.1 a the result is 9.998 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: ty 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.941 %（-20.6%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising ty by 10% changes the result to 7.941 % (-20.6%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「半衰期與活度衰減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Half-life and decay of activity"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要每個人都不超過法定劑量限值，就不需要再做任何最佳化。
以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as nobody exceeds the legal dose limit, no further optimisation is needed.

Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal.
quiz.explanation: 以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「半衰期與活度衰減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Half-life and decay of activity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：廢棄物包件的核種清單、量測日期與不確定度要隨包件終身保存，處置場的總量控制以長半衰期核種為準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Nuclide inventory, measurement date and uncertainty must stay with each package for life, and repository totals should be controlled on long-lived nuclides.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA SSR-5 放射性廢棄物處置。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA SSR-5 Disposal of Radioactive Waste. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「半衰期與活度衰減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Half-life and decay of activity" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。
optionsEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor.
quiz.explanation: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「半衰期與活度衰減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Half-life and decay of activity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：廢棄物的危害期長短取決於其中主要核種的半衰期：銫-137 與鍶-90 約三十年，經過三百年（十個半衰期）只剩約千分之一，這是低放射性廢棄物處置設施以數百年作為監管期的依據；長半衰期核種則需要深層地質處置把隔離時間拉長到數萬年以上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。
knowledge.textEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「每個密封筒的熱負載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Heat load of one canister" is correct?
options: 用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。
乾式貯存既然不用水冷，就表示燃料已經不會發熱。
用過燃料剛從反應爐退出時，每一束的衰變熱高達數十萬瓦，必須泡在水裡。
optionsEn: Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor.
Since dry storage uses no water cooling, the fuel must no longer produce heat.
Fresh from the reactor each assembly gives off hundreds of kilowatts of decay heat and has to sit in water.
quiz.explanation: 用過燃料剛從反應爐退出時，每一束的衰變熱高達數十萬瓦，必須泡在水裡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fresh from the reactor each assembly gives off hundreds of kilowatts of decay heat and has to sit in water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 每個密封筒的熱負載：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat load of one canister: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「每個密封筒的熱負載」如何決定「乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heat load of one canister” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 用過燃料剛從反應爐退出時，每一束的衰變熱高達數十萬瓦，必須泡在水裡。在水池冷卻五年後，一束壓水式燃料的發熱降到一千瓦以下，相當於一台電暖器；這時把數十束裝進同一個密封筒，總發熱約為兩三萬瓦，可以靠空氣自然對流帶走。每一種護箱都有執照核定的熱負載上限，裝載時必須依每束燃料的燃耗與冷卻時間計算，並把較熱的燃料放在散熱較好的位置。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh from the reactor each assembly gives off hundreds of kilowatts of decay heat and has to sit in water. After five years in a pool a pressurized-water assembly is below a kilowatt, like an electric heater; tens of them loaded into one canister total twenty to thirty kilowatts, which natural convection of air can remove. Each cask design has a licensed heat-load limit, and loading must be calculated from burnup and cooling time of every assembly, with hotter fuel placed where cooling is better. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：一個密封筒可裝約 37 束壓水式或 89 束沸水式燃料
steps.observationEn: Project file: One canister holds about 37 PWR or 89 BWR assemblies
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「每個密封筒的熱負載」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Heat load of one canister”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 用過燃料剛從反應爐退出時，每一束的衰變熱高達數十萬瓦，必須泡在水裡。在水池冷卻五年後，一束壓水式燃料的發熱降到一千瓦以下，相當於一台電暖器；這時把數十束裝進同一個密封筒，總發熱約為兩三萬瓦，可以靠空氣自然對流帶走。每一種護箱都有執照核定的熱負載上限，裝載時必須依每束燃料的燃耗與冷卻時間計算，並把較熱的燃料放在散熱較好的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Fresh from the reactor each assembly gives off hundreds of kilowatts of decay heat and has to sit in water. After five years in a pool a pressurized-water assembly is below a kilowatt, like an electric heater; tens of them loaded into one canister total twenty to thirty kilowatts, which natural convection of air can remove. Each cask design has a licensed heat-load limit, and loading must be calculated from burnup and cooling time of every assembly, with hotter fuel placed where cooling is better.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「每個密封筒的熱負載」的模型 Q = n·q，37 束、每束平均發熱 0.8 kW 時的總熱負載（每束發熱為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = n·q for "Heat load of one canister", which value is closest to the total heat load for 37 assemblies at a mean 0.8 kW each (representative heat per assembly)?
options: 296 kW
optionsEn: 296 kW
quiz.explanation: Q = n·q；代入 n = 37、q = 0.8 kW，得 29.6 kW（37 束、每束平均發熱 0.8 kW 時的總熱負載（每束發熱為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = n·q; with n = 37, q = 0.8 kW the result is 29.6 kW (total heat load for 37 assemblies at a mean 0.8 kW each (representative heat per assembly)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 每個密封筒的熱負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heat load of one canister: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每個密封筒的熱負載」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Heat load of one canister” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = n·q；代入 n = 37、q = 0.8 kW，得 29.6 kW（37 束、每束平均發熱 0.8 kW 時的總熱負載（每束發熱為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = n·q; with n = 37, q = 0.8 kW the result is 29.6 kW (total heat load for 37 assemblies at a mean 0.8 kW each (representative heat per assembly)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 32.6 kW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 32.6 kW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 29.6 kW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 29.6 kW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in q with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = n·q；代入 n = 37、q = 0.8 kW，得 29.6 kW（37 束、每束平均發熱 0.8 kW 時的總熱負載（每束發熱為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: Q = n·q; with n = 37, q = 0.8 kW the result is 29.6 kW (total heat load for 37 assemblies at a mean 0.8 kW each (representative heat per assembly)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 32.6 kW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising q by 10% changes the result to 32.6 kW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「每個密封筒的熱負載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Heat load of one canister"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
裝載前以燃料管理程式計算每束的衰變熱並由獨立人員複核，裝載後量測護箱進出口的空氣溫差以反推實際熱負載。
屏蔽厚度加倍，輻射強度就減半。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Before loading a fuel-management code computes decay heat of each assembly with independent review, and afterwards air temperature difference across the cask infers the actual heat load.
Doubling shield thickness halves the radiation intensity.
quiz.explanation: 裝載前以燃料管理程式計算每束的衰變熱並由獨立人員複核，裝載後量測護箱進出口的空氣溫差以反推實際熱負載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before loading a fuel-management code computes decay heat of each assembly with independent review, and afterwards air temperature difference across the cask infers the actual heat load. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 每個密封筒的熱負載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat load of one canister: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每個密封筒的熱負載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heat load of one canister” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 裝載前以燃料管理程式計算每束的衰變熱並由獨立人員複核，裝載後量測護箱進出口的空氣溫差以反推實際熱負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before loading a fuel-management code computes decay heat of each assembly with independent review, and afterwards air temperature difference across the cask infers the actual heat load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：裝載計畫要逐束核對燃耗、冷卻時間與位置，並以保守的衰變熱計算保留溫度餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check burnup, cooling time and position of each assembly in a loading plan, and keep temperature margin with conservative decay-heat calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若誤把冷卻時間不足的燃料裝入，護套溫度可能超過限值，長期下來鋯合金中的氫化物重新排列而變脆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fuel loaded with too little cooling time may exceed the cladding temperature limit, and over the long term hydrides in the zirconium alloy reorient and embrittle it. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 裝載前以燃料管理程式計算每束的衰變熱並由獨立人員複核，裝載後量測護箱進出口的空氣溫差以反推實際熱負載。
knowledge.textEn: Before loading a fuel-management code computes decay heat of each assembly with independent review, and afterwards air temperature difference across the cask infers the actual heat load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 裝載計畫要逐束核對燃耗、冷卻時間與位置，並以保守的衰變熱計算保留溫度餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Check burnup, cooling time and position of each assembly in a loading plan, and keep temperature margin with conservative decay-heat calculation.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA GSR Part 6 設施除役。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA GSR Part 6 Decommissioning of Facilities. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「每個密封筒的熱負載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Heat load of one canister" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
乾式貯存既然不用水冷，就表示燃料已經不會發熱。
若誤把冷卻時間不足的燃料裝入，護套溫度可能超過限值，長期下來鋯合金中的氫化物重新排列而變脆。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Since dry storage uses no water cooling, the fuel must no longer produce heat.
Fuel loaded with too little cooling time may exceed the cladding temperature limit, and over the long term hydrides in the zirconium alloy reorient and embrittle it.
quiz.explanation: 若誤把冷卻時間不足的燃料裝入，護套溫度可能超過限值，長期下來鋯合金中的氫化物重新排列而變脆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fuel loaded with too little cooling time may exceed the cladding temperature limit, and over the long term hydrides in the zirconium alloy reorient and embrittle it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 每個密封筒的熱負載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heat load of one canister: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每個密封筒的熱負載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Heat load of one canister” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若誤把冷卻時間不足的燃料裝入，護套溫度可能超過限值，長期下來鋯合金中的氫化物重新排列而變脆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Fuel loaded with too little cooling time may exceed the cladding temperature limit, and over the long term hydrides in the zirconium alloy reorient and embrittle it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一種護箱都有執照核定的熱負載上限，裝載時必須依每束燃料的燃耗與冷卻時間計算，並把較熱的燃料放在散熱較好的位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each cask design has a licensed heat-load limit, and loading must be calculated from burnup and cooling time of every assembly, with hotter fuel placed where cooling is better.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「用過燃料離開反應爐之後就不再發熱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spent fuel generates no heat once it leaves the reactor." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若誤把冷卻時間不足的燃料裝入，護套溫度可能超過限值，長期下來鋯合金中的氫化物重新排列而變脆。
knowledge.textEn: Fuel loaded with too little cooling time may exceed the cladding temperature limit, and over the long term hydrides in the zirconium alloy reorient and embrittle it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
